field: K_proj = C(P(W))^G with trdeg_C = 4; K_aff = C(W)^G pure transcendental of degree 1 over K_proj

f5.divisor_source: V(f5) subset P(W), integral normal quintic
f5.quotient_center: image D5 of V(f5) in the geometric quotient; one prime (geometrically integral)
f5.uniformizer_K_proj_open: pi5 = f3*f5/f8 on the open f3*f8 != 0
f5.inertia: trivial: a nonidentity projective linear g cannot fix an irreducible nonlinear hypersurface pointwise
f5.decomposition_group: full G (only surviving unramified full-group class after V3/A5 elimination)
f5.residue_field: kappa5 = Frac(R/(f5)) degree-zero part for K_proj; free rank-12 over C(f3,f6,f8,f11) before localization
f5.residue_G_torsor: unramified generic G-torsor reduces to a genuine G-torsor over kappa5 (finite-etale equivalence for henselian rings; not a single H90 matrix reduction)
f5.gauge_independence: any two Hilbert-90 frames differ by GL_5 on a common open; integral models with unit determinant reduce to isomorphic residue twists
f5.retired_bounded_fact: degree-16 support-at-most-five emptiness on the Hironaka quotient (V-F5-DEGREE16-SUPPORT-LE5-EMPTY) is consumed only as a finite support theorem, not as full residue pointlessness

f6.divisor_source: V(f6) subset P(W), geometrically integral sextic
f6.quotient_center: image D6 of V(f6); one prime
f6.uniformizer_K_proj_open: pi6 = f3^2/f5 * (f6-free alternate) or f6/f3^2 after tau-open; use affine f6 on K_aff
f6.alternate_weight_one_gauge: q6 = f3^2/f5 is a unit at f6=0 when f3,f5 != 0
f6.residue_G_torsor: unramified reduction of the generic G-torsor; genuine residue G-torsor
f6.gauge_independence: same GL_5 open argument as f5
